author: Jhon
body:
Hello !, this is my first map to Avicus, is the theme of the walls and I have relied on the forest and mine is small but fun, the chests are scattered the entire map and loot already in place, sand the walls are already in place and there is no difference between areas, colors are green, yellow, red and blue.

to appreciate better I recommend you look the map for yourself

[my native language is Spanish, not English, so I apologize for as I write.]

Hopefully you like the map, below are some images of the map itself.

Thank you for your attention ^^

V1.3
[-] added a bow in the center of the map
[-] Fixed 1.8 - 1.7 problems whit chests
[-] Removed Part of TNT and Sugar Canes. (In the images this part not are fix, but in the map are fixed)
[V1.3] Download the map: http://www.mediafire.com/download/3728art5h47rmas/The+Walls+-+Avic_us+V1.3+by+Jhon.rar
By Jhon

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Ok, I like the mini-map concept, fits well with some of our other maps! good job.

The map is pretty clean on top, should play fine. my problem is all the lava lakes under the ground. mining is also kinda tough so please take a look at that. Lastly, the map was made in 1.8, so now most of the chests are empty. please use 1.7.10 or lower to refill the empty chests, and make any changes. 

Thanks!
